.vbox-preloader{
    position:fixed; 
    width:32px; 
    height:32px;
    left:50%; 
    top:50%; 
    margin-left:-16px; 
    margin-top:-16px;
    background-image: url(../images/preload-circle.png);
    text-indent: -100px;
    overflow: hidden;
    -webkit-animation: playload 1.4s steps(18) infinite;

            animation: playload 1.4s steps(18) infinite;
}

   from { background-position:    0px; }

   from { background-position:    0px; }

}

}

   from { background-position:    0px; }
     to { background-position: -576px; }
}
@keyframes playload {
   from { background-position:    0px; }
     to { background-position: -576px; }
}
